name: 沈时渡
imagePrompt: SCENERY -- wide shot through office glass into blue-grey dusk. Distant city towers with a few warm yellow window lights, deep cold autumn evening, scattered small points over a dark horizon, no humans visible, low-key ambience with reflective faint light on the near floor inside. Moody and contemplative framing looking out and down.
note:
十九点的办公室，已经静下来。

这杯黑咖啡，终于还是见了杯底。对面的楼层，一盏一盏的，暗下去的灯比还亮着的要多。窗缝渗进来一丝冷风。我把腕上的表盘按了按，盯着那片楼看了好一会儿——

是深秋了。夜里开始有真正的寒意。

这周末，也并没有非要去赴的约会。
